title: Caveat emptor as an obstacle to business transfers: Effect of product line liability exceptions on acquisitions, entry, and exit

rival_explanations: pre-existing declining trend in acquisitions mistaken for the PLE effect
a coincident state-level shock (e.g., a more consumer-friendly government) that also drove PLE adoption
pre-existing rising trend in closures mistaken for the PLE effect
a coincident state-level shock (e.g., a more consumer-friendly government) affecting all businesses
a coincident state-level shock (e.g., a more consumer-friendly government) affecting all businesses
